text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew... What a nice tension.
I can feel things gradually heating up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"My heart is beating just as fast as when I win.
...It's as if my body is already certain of victory."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: When I close my eyes, I see it clearly. A brilliant vision of us running along the road of glory—and sharing that joy together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go seize our happy ending!
